# Aera

> Aera is a media studio based in Leeds, UK, with a second base in Dubai. It
> makes photography, video and social media content for brands and events:
> event coverage, commercial and product shoots, brand films, and monthly
> social media content and management. Started by Jack Careem in 2026 and
> launched in September 2026; bookings are open.

## Services

- [Social media content & management](https://aerastudios.org/social-media): A monthly shoot, reels and posts cut to one consistent style, with posting handled if wanted. Starter content set from £300; monthly £300 to £500; full management quoted.
- [Commercial & product photography and video](https://aerastudios.org/brand-commercial): Product, headshot, portrait and campaign photography plus brand video for businesses. Sessions from £150; content day from £250.
- [Event photography & videography](https://aerastudios.org/events): Launches, parties, theatre, car meets and corporate days, with an edited gallery and a 60 to 90 second recap film the same week. Half day from £250; full day from £450.

## Team

- [Jack Careem](https://aerastudios.org/jack-careem): Founder, photographer and filmmaker, Leeds.
- [Toosh Alzaeem](https://aerastudios.org/toosh-alzaeem): Photographer and videographer, Bournemouth.
- [Vance Serania](https://aerastudios.org/vance-serania): Middle East lead, filmmaker and photographer, Dubai. Brand work for Rolls-Royce, KIA Motors and F1rst Motors.
